name: CreditMemo
description: A financial transaction representing a refund or credit of payment, or part of a payment, for goods or services that have been sold.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. Required for update.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of a transaction. Valid Line types include: SalesItemLine, GroupLine, DescriptionOnlyLine, DiscountLine and SubTotalLine.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: The Id of the line item.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: The line number / position of the line item.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form text description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The detail type of the line item.

attributes.name: SalesItemLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for a sales item line.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced item.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the tax code for the line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the item.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price of the item.

attributes.name: SubTotalLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for a subtotal line.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to a customer or job. Use Customer.Id and Customer.DisplayName for CustomerRef.value and CustomerRef.name, respectively.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced customer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced customer.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the associated transaction are expressed. Conditionally required; must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 code for the currency.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full name of the currency.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Conditionally required; not applicable to US companies, required for non-US companies.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project ID associated with this transaction. Conditionally required.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced project.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced project.

fields.name: BillEmail
fields.description: Identifies the e-mail address where the credit-memo is sent. Conditionally required: if EmailStatus=NeedToSend, BillEmail is a required input.

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: The email address.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. If not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: One of, up to three custom fields for the transaction. Available for custom fields so configured for the company.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: The Id of the custom field definition.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the custom field.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The data type of the custom field.

attributes.name: StringValue
attributes.description: The string value of the custom field.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the transaction. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.ClassTrackingPerLine is true.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced class.

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Printing status of the credit-memo.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales term associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced sales term.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced sales term.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Indicates the total amount of the transaction, including the total of all charges, allowances, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic; any value supplied is over-written by QuickBooks.

fields.name: ApplyTaxAfterDiscount
fields.description: If false or null, calculate the sales tax first then apply the discount. If true, subtract the discount first then calculate the sales tax. US versions of QuickBooks only.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. Behavior depends on Preferences:CustomTxnNumber. Optional for all locales except France.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. This note does not appear on the deposit form.

fields.name: CustomerMemo
fields.description: User-entered message to the customer; this message is visible to the end user on their transactions.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The text of the memo.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Information for taxes charged on the transaction as a whole. Can be calculated by QuickBooks business logic or supplied when adding a transaction.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any tax lines manually inserted into the transaction line list.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction tax code.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Tax line detail.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to a PaymentMethod associated with this transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced payment method.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced payment method.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of the currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Identifies the address where the goods must be shipped.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Id of the address object.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state name for US.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal code.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of geocoded address.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: A reference to a Department object specifying the location of the transaction. Available if Preferences.AccountingInfoPrefs.TrackDepartments is true.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced department.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced department.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email status of the credit-memo.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Bill-to address of the credit memo.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Id of the address object.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state name for US.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal code.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of geocoded address.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: HomeBalance
fields.description: Convenience field containing the amount in Balance expressed in terms of the home currency. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic. Valid only when CurrencyRef is specified; applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: RemainingCredit
fields.description: Indicates the total credit amount still available to apply towards the payment.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction. Captures what recurring transaction template the CreditMemo was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced recurring transaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced recurring transaction.

fields.name: TaxExemptionRef
fields.description: Reference to the TaxExemption ID associated with this object. Available for companies that have automated sales tax enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The system-generated Id of the exemption type. For internal use only.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The Tax Exemption Id for the customer to which this object is associated. Typically issued by the state.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: The balance reflecting any payments made against the transaction. Initially set to the value of TotalAmt. A Balance of 0 indicates the invoice is fully paid. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic; any value supplied is over-written by QuickBooks.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency, including the total of all charges, allowances and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks business logic. Valid only when CurrencyRef is specified; applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

specialOperations.name: Get a credit memo as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified credit memo as an Adobe PDF file, formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) the credit memo belongs to.

pathParams.name: creditmemoId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the credit memo to retrieve as PDF.

specialOperations.note: Returns a binary PDF (application/pdf) instead of a JSON response body.

specialOperations.name: Send a credit memo
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified credit memo to the customer and sets EmailStatus to EmailSent, populating DeliveryInfo.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) the credit memo belongs to.

pathParams.name: creditmemoId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the credit memo to send.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Explicit email address to send the credit memo to; if specified, CreditMemo.BillEmail.Address is updated to this value.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit (no sendTo, uses the address in CreditMemo.BillEmail.EmailAddress) vs explicit (POST .../send?sendTo=<emailAddress>). Sets EmailStatus=EmailSent and populates CreditMemo.DeliveryInfo.
